items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: And Sam Majada played tenor and Paul played trombone and bass. That's the same band.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's the same band. He got the picture. Yeah, Sam Majada played clarinet. And Sam Majada played tenor and Paul played trombone and bass. That's the same band. A police band.
Yeah. And you played with him much before in the 20s? Yeah, he had a spot job. Who was in the band? Was it a family band or was it a different guy or what? Do you remember?
